pages.text: The compacting bin is useful for creating a variety of compressed blocks from loose materials.$(br2) Particularly, I can compact dirt into $(l:construction/construction)rammed earth$() for building, or refractory material into $(l:innovation/advanced_crafting/ware_crafting)modeling refractory material$() blocks, among other things.
Later on, I could iterate on this design for gravity to do the work for me automatically. A mechanical compacting bin would only require a simple cog to work on its own at a stable pace.
